name: Site Root Prefix
purpose: deploy the same canonical site tree beneath a temporary test prefix or directly at the domain root without changing target-internal logical paths
rules: target scripts declare canonical logical site paths only
the prefix is applied exactly once by lib/site-root.sh
the literal word test must not be copied into application repositories or target logical paths
empty prefix is an explicit production cutover choice
existing production IAM/LMTS targets remain separate until their candidate migration is ready
prefix must be empty or an absolute traversal-free path
